target.authentication: per-user Basic username/password plus server-issued short-lived accessToken request header

policy: The fixed Confluence Server adapter uses REST API v1 and the company CLI authentication contract. Per-user Basic credentials are encrypted in Connection; the short-lived accessToken is issued and cached by a server-side Token Provider from injected JIRA_TOKEN_* secrets. It does not execute local CLI commands or read CLI config at runtime. Confluence Cloud site URLs, Cloud API v2 and file transfer are excluded.
modifications: Replace OpenConnector Confluence Cloud site URL and API v2 transport with fixed company Confluence Server REST API v1.
Move the CLI header command's application token exchange to the shared server-side Token Provider while keeping per-user Basic identity.
Preserve OpenConnector Confluence action names and input semantics where the Server API supports them.

Add reviewed Server page, hierarchy, history, move, delete, comment, space and attachment metadata actions; file upload/download are excluded from JSON MCP input until a bounded file contract is approved.
